title: Restriction of the sheafified scalar tensor construction
statement: Fix l, E, T, U and an exponent n+1 [def-sf-clopen-restriction-data, def-weil-integral-reduction-tower]. Let A be a recorded normalized scalar model for the raw restriction of the completed-to-finite coefficient map to U [def-weil-pbc-system-scalar-model]. Raw restriction of a completed module followed by A is naturally isomorphic to ordinary global reduction followed by raw restriction of the finite module. The isomorphism sends the model pure tensor with coefficient s and section x to the same sheafified global tensor, on each object of the open site. No local coefficient isomorphisms, derived comparison, or completed scalar restriction are involved.

source.place: Tags 03EL and 03CY, tensor construction and compatibility with sheafification on the open site.

proof.text: Apply the existing oldScalarBackIso to the open site inclusion, which is continuous and cocontinuous. Compare its tensor-sheaf objects with the specified global and raw-local functors by their object equations. Check naturality using their map equations and oldScalarBackIso_natural.

Express the recorded model pure tensor as the sheafification-unit image of the actual pure tensor, using linearity to move the scalar onto 1 tensor x. Cancel the object-transport maps. oldScalarBackIso_pure then gives the normalized section formula. The maps and inverse work for empty components and zero rings.

theorem sf_clopen_scalar_raw_restriction_comparison
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (T : Scheme.{t}) (U : T.Opens) (n : ℕ)
    (A : SystemScalarModel.{t + 1, t, max u (t + 1)} (J := ProEt.topology U.toScheme)
      ((clopenTensorRings.{t, u} U.ι).map
        (completedIntegralCommRingProjectionUnrestricted l E T n))) :
    ∃ back :
    clopenTensorRestriction.{t, u} U.ι
        (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E T) ⋙ A.model.E ≅
      scalarReductionExtension l E T n ⋙
        clopenTensorRestriction.{t, u} U.ι (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E T n),
      ∀ (M : scalarReductionSource l E T) (V : U.toScheme.ProEtᵒᵖ)
        (s : (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E T n).obj.obj
          ((sfClopenSiteInclusion U).op.obj V))
        (x : M.val.obj ((sfClopenSiteInclusion U).op.obj V)),
      ((back.hom.app M).val.app V)
        (systemModelTmul A.model
          ((clopenTensorRestriction.{t, u} U.ι
            (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E T)).obj M) V s x) =
        unrestrictedTowerTensorSection l E T n M ((sfClopenSiteInclusion U).op.obj V)
          s x
